description: Code Ninjas is a child-focused education franchise founded in 2016, operating learning centers of 1,100 to 1,500 square feet teaching kids coding, programming, math, and STEM skills, plus a smaller Studio Center format. The franchisor, Code Ninjas, LLC of Peachtree Corners, Georgia, is majority-owned through private equity (Eagle Merchant Partners) and began franchising in November 2016. Per the 2026 FDD, a Learning Center franchise fee is $45,000 with total initial investment of $174,250 to $265,750, royalties of 8.25% of net sales plus a 2.0% marketing contribution, and a typical protected area of 1.5 to 2 miles. The system totaled 245 outlets at the end of 2025 (238 franchised, down from 284 in 2023) across 35 states; Item 19 reports 2025 average annual gross sales of $235,927 across 224 reporting locations.
territoryDescription: Non-exclusive: a typical Protected Area encompasses a 1.5 to 2 mile radius around the Learning Center; no other Code Ninjas Learning Center will be established inside it while the franchisee is compliant; no sales quota required to keep it. Franchisor retains all other rights, including non-System businesses anywhere and e-commerce/retail distribution of products and services anywhere outside a Learning Center in the Protected Area.

initial_franchise_fee_model.value: Learning Center: $45,000 (uniform for new franchisees, non-refundable, lump sum on signing). Studio Center: $35,000. In our last fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, Learning Center initial franchise fees collected ranged from $20,000 to $40,000

franchise_fee_veteran_discount.value: 10% discount from the initial franchise fee for qualified U.S. military veterans and active-duty personnel (51%+ owner if an entity); discount must be repaid on transfer within the first 2 years

new_franchisee_training_fee.value: $750 per attendee, non-refundable, payable before Initial Management Training

development_fee.value: $45,000 for the first Learning Center + $25,000 for each additional Learning Center under a Development Agreement (minimum 2 centers); lump sum, non-refundable; credited against each unit's initial franchise fee while compliant

development_agreement_total_example.value: Three Learning Centers under a Development Agreement: development fee $95,750; total investment $224,250 to $315,750 (includes $95,750 paid to us or affiliate)
development_agreement_total_example.note: cite: FDD Item 7 Table C, p.18

preopening_minimum_royalty.value: $500 per month (pro-rated) for each month past the Opening Deadline until the Learning Center opens; franchisor retains termination rights

marketing_contribution.value: 2.0% of Net Sales to the Brand Marketing Development Fund

marketing_advertising_expenses.value: $350/month (current) for the franchisor's in-house advertising agency producing/placing local digital marketing — mandatory; increases capped at 10% per calendar year; third-party placement costs are extra

technology_fee.value: $350/month (current) covering technology services/licenses; may increase up to 10% per year; additional fees to third-party technology vendors

additional_training_fee.value: Additional/repeat initial training: $750 per individual; ongoing/remedial training: $500–$1,000 per day per trainer plus expenses

convention_fee.value: If held: $750 per attendee (current); controlling-interest holder and Designated Principal must register and attend

renewal_fee.value: $3,500, due on signing the Renewal Agreement (instead of a new initial franchise fee)

transfer_fee.value: $5,000 for a controlling ownership interest transfer; $2,500 for non-controlling interests or transfers to a wholly owned entity; no fee on death/disability transfer (out-of-pocket expenses reimbursed)

management_fee.value: $275 per day if the franchisor takes over temporary operation on death/incapacity of the Designated Principal

noncompliance_fee.value: $500 per week for each week a default remains uncured

audit_expense_rule.value: Franchisee reimburses inspection/audit expenses if Net Sales were understated by 2.0% or more (deemed materially inaccurate) or records not maintained

liquidated_damages.value: Average monthly royalty + marketing contributions for the 24 months before termination (or months operated, if fewer) × the lesser of 24 or months remaining in the term

net_sales_definition.value: All revenue from the sale of all Services and Products and all other income related to, derived from, or originating from the Learning Center, including barter and business-interruption insurance proceeds; excluding sales taxes and good-faith refunds/discounts

investment_model_note.value: Learning Center (Table A): $174,250 to $265,750, includes $45,750 paid to us or affiliate ($45,000 franchise fee + $750 training fee). Studio Center (Table B): $73,500 to $109,250, includes $35,750 paid to us or affiliate. Development (3 centers, Table C): $224,250 to $315,750

grand_opening_min.value: $8,000 minimum for the grand opening marketing program (60 days before to 60 days after opening)

prototype_sqft.value: Learning Center: 1,100 to 1,500 square feet; Studio Center: under 1,000 sq ft or hosted in third-party spaces (schools, community centers) with a 12-month host commitment
prototype_sqft.note: cite: FDD Item 1, p.3 + Item 7 note 4, p.19

buildout_cost_per_sqft.value: About $85 to $150 per square foot for 1,100–1,500 sq ft; construction $50,000–$90,000; architect $1,500–$5,000

additional_funds_3mo.value: $20,000 to $30,000 for ongoing expenses during the 3-month start-up phase

financing_offered.value: No — 'We do not generally offer, directly or indirectly, any financing to you'; no guarantee of notes, leases, or obligations

initial_training.value: Initial Management Training: Owners Training + Brand Management Training in the Atlanta metropolitan area or a location we specify; ~4 days for the Designated Principal or Center Director (per diem/travel estimate $375/person); New Franchisee Training Fee $750 per attendee
initial_training.note: cite: FDD Item 11 + Exhibit A §6.2 + Item 7 note 5, p.19

local_marketing_spend.value: Each Period: $2,000 to $2,500 per month for the first 24 months after opening; 4.0% of Net Sales from month 24 on — mandatory (Franchise Agreement §13.1); no local advertising co-op currently required
local_marketing_spend.note: cite: FDD Item 11, p.29 + Exhibit A §13.1

brand_fund_spend_2025.value: FY2025 Brand Fund contributions used for: production of advertising/promotional materials (33%), media placement (33%), administrative expenses (33%)

territory_exclusive.value: No — 'You will not receive an exclusive territory.'

territory_protected_area.value: Protected Area designated in the Franchise Agreement: a typical Protected Area encompasses a 1.5 to 2 mile radius around the Learning Center; franchisor will not establish/ license another Learning Center inside it while the franchisee is compliant

territory_sales_quota.value: None — no sales/revenue volume required to keep the Protected Area; franchisor may not modify it while the franchisee is compliant

franchisor_reserved_rights.value: Franchisor and affiliates retain all rights not granted, including: establishing Learning Centers outside the Protected Area; operating non-System businesses anywhere; acquiring/be acquired; selling Services/Products through any channel (e-commerce, retailers) anywhere except from a Learning Center inside the Protected Area

territory_relocation.value: No right to relocate without prior written approval; requests evaluated under current site-selection criteria

trademarks.value: CODE NINJAS — USPTO Reg. 5303101 (Oct 3, 2017), 5325349 (Oct 31, 2017), 7311069 (Feb 20, 2024); no effective USPTO/state/court determinations, no pending interference/opposition/cancellation, no agreements materially limiting use

patents_copyrights.value: No patents; proprietary Brand Manual, curriculum, software, and trade dress; franchisee receives only a license to use the Proprietary Marks

owner_participation.value: Must participate in day-to-day management; entity owners must appoint a Designated Principal (≥10% equity) who completes training and has full decision authority; if the principal is not full-time, employ a full-time Center Director who completed initial training

sell_restrictions.value: Offer and sell only approved goods/services; offer all approved goods/services; services rendered only by trained personnel; retail sales only unless approved; franchisor may add authorized Products/Services with no limits

renewal_terms.value: 3 additional 10-year terms by signing the then-current franchise agreement (terms may differ materially), subject to compliance, general release, and payment of the $3,500 renewal fee

post_term_noncompete.value: 2-year prohibition on engaging in a Competitive Business after expiration, termination, or transfer

dispute_resolution.value: Non-binding mediation first (except injunctive relief); then litigation; waiver of jury trial; choice of forum: courts with jurisdiction over the franchisor's then-principal place of business; Georgia law governs

public_figures.value: None — 'We do not use any public figures to promote our franchise.'

risk_score.item: THEORETICAL — method: base 20 +6 outlet contraction (284→238 franchised, −16.2%, 2023–2025) +6 high attrition (2024: 8 terminations + 20 non-renewals = 28 of 262 start-year outlets; 2025: 13) +5 ongoing fee burden (8.25% royalty + 2.0% marketing + $2,000–$2,500/mo local spend for 24 months then 4% of net sales + $350/mo tech + $350/mo agency) +4 capital intensity (ceiling $265,750; $45,750 to franchisor/affiliate) +2 PE control (Eagle Merchant Partners ultimate manager) −3 Item 19 disclosed (n=224, avg annual gross sales $235,927; sales-only, no profit) −2 audited financials attached (Exhibit G) −2 clean litigation/bankruptcy record (none disclosed, Items 3–4) = 36/100

fee_burden_ratio_pct.item: THEORETICAL — method: $45,750 (fee + training, paid to franchisor/affiliate) / $174,250 (Item 7 min investment) = 26.26%

ongoing_fee_burden_pct.item: THEORETICAL — method: Learning Center royalty 8.25% + marketing contribution 2.0% = 10.25% of net sales ongoing, PLUS $2,000–$2,500/mo local spend for 24 months then 4.0% of net sales (FA §13.1), plus $350/mo tech and $350/mo agency

item19_confidence.item: THEORETICAL — method: n=224 (94.1% of 238 franchised outlets), 2025 data, average/median/high/low disclosed — but gross-sales-only, no cost or profit figures

unit_growth_2023_2025_pct.item: THEORETICAL — method: (238 − 284) / 284 = −16.2% franchised outlet contraction, 2023–2025 (Item 20 Table No. 1)

litigation_risk_flag.item: THEORETICAL — method: no litigation or bankruptcy disclosed (Items 3–4); one independent franchisee association exists (IACNF)
